z_Yield_mm_log)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ModelTemp-EcoDrought-withCovs_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-19-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Specify JAGS model Specify hierarchical model following Letcher et al. (2016). MODIFIED: * estimate all main parameters hierarchically (intercept, air temp, lagged air temp, flow, and temp-flow interaction effects) * add prior on covariates to deal with missing values * calculate Bayesian R^2 and RMSE * remove the year trends and random effects (same as for Hocking et al 2018) * add catchment covariate effects on random effects parameters, hierarchical by basin ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cat("model { ###----------------- LIKELIHOOD -----------------### # Days without an observation on the previous day (first observation in a series) # No autoregressive term for (i in 1:nFirstObsRows){ temp[firstObsRows[i]] ~ dnorm(stream.mu[firstObsRows[i]], pow(sigma, -2)) stream.mu[firstObsRows[i]] <- trend[firstObsRows[i]] trend[firstObsRows[i]] <- inprod(B.site[site[firstObsRows[i]], ], X.site[firstObsRows[i], ]) } # Days with an observation on the previous dat (all days following the first day) # Includes autoregressive term (ar1) for (i in 1:nEvalRows){ temp[evalRows[i]] ~ dnorm(stream.mu[evalRows[i]], pow(sigma, -2)) stream.mu[evalRows[i]] <- trend[evalRows[i]] + ar1[site[evalRows[i]]] * (temp[evalRows[i]-1] - trend[ evalRows[i]-1 ]) trend[evalRows[i]] <- inprod(B.site[site[evalRows[i]], ], X.site[evalRows[i], ]) } # Prior on covariates to handle missing (flow) data for (i in 1:n){ for (k in 1:Krandom) { X.site[i,k] ~ dnorm(0, pow(1, -2)) } } # Save log-likelihoods for LOO-CV for (i in 1:n) { loglik[i] <- logdensity.norm(temp[i], stream.mu[i], pow(sigma, -2)) } ###----------------- PRIORS ---------------------### # ar1, hierarchical by site for (i in 1:nsites){ ar1[i] ~ dnorm(ar1Mean, pow(ar1SD, -2)) T(-1,1) } ar1Mean ~ dunif(-1, 1) ar1SD ~ dunif(0, 2) # model variance sigma ~ dunif(0, 100) # random effect coefficients (by site with covariate effects, hierarchical by basin) for (k in 1:Krandom) { # site level regressions for (i in 1:nsites) { B.site[i,k] ~ dnorm(mu.B.site[i,k], pow(sigma.B.site[k], -2)) mu.B.site[i,k] <- alpha.0[basin[i],k] + alpha.1[basin[i],k] * elev[i] #+ alpha.2[basin[i],k] * area[i] + alpha.3[basin[i],k] * elev[i] * area[i] } # basin level variation in elevation effects for (j in 1:nbasins) { alpha.0[j,k] ~ dnorm(mu.alpha.0[k], pow(sigma.alpha.0[k], -2)) alpha.1[j,k] ~ dnorm(mu.alpha.1[k], pow(sigma.alpha.1[k], -2)) # alpha.2[j,k] ~ dnorm(mu.alpha.2[k], pow(sigma.alpha.2[k], -2)) # alpha.3[j,k] ~ dnorm(mu.alpha.3[k], pow(sigma.alpha.3[k], -2)) } # hyperpriors: global means and standard deviations mu.alpha.0[k] ~ dnorm(0, pow(10, -2)) mu.alpha.1[k] ~ dnorm(0, pow(10, -2)) # mu.alpha.2[k] ~ dnorm(0, pow(10, -2)) # mu.alpha.3[k] ~ dnorm(0, pow(10, -2)) sigma.B.site[k] ~ dunif(0, 100) sigma.alpha.0[k] ~ dunif(0, 100) sigma.alpha.1[k] ~ dunif(0, 100) # sigma.alpha.2[k] ~ dunif(0, 100) # sigma.alpha.3[k] ~ dunif(0, 100) } ###----------------- DERIVED VALUES -------------### for (i in 1:n) { residuals[i] <- temp[i] - stream.mu[i] } # variance of model predictions (fixed + random effects) var_fit <- (sd(stream.mu))^2 # residual variance var_res <- (sd(residuals))^2 # calculate Bayesian R^2 R2 <- var_fit / (var_fit + var_res) # Root mean squared error rmse <- sqrt(mean(residuals[]^2)) }", file = "JAGS models/DailyTempModelJAGS_Letcher_hierarchical_modified_site-basin.txt") ``` ::: ## Organize objects Get first observation indices and check that nFirstRowObs equals the number of unique site-years: **must be TRUE!** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # row indices for first observation in each site-year firstObsRows <- unlist(dat %>% group_by(siteYear) %>% summarize(index = rowNum[min(which(!is.na(tempc_mean)))]) %>% ungroup() %>% select(index)) nFirstObsRows <- length(firstObsRows) # does the number of first observations match the number of site years? nFirstObsRows == length(unique(dat$siteYear)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] TRUE ``` ::: ::: Get row indices for all other observations ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} evalRows <- unlist(dat %>% filter(!rowNum %in% firstObsRows) %>% select(rowNum)) nEvalRows <- length(evalRows) ``` ::: Fixed and random effect data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} data.random <- data.frame(intercept = 1, airTemp = dat$z_air_temp_mean, flow = dat$z_Yield_mm_log, airFlow = dat$z_air_temp_mean * dat$z_Yield_mm_log, airTempLag1 = dat$z_air_temp_mean_lag1, airTempLag2 = dat$z_air_temp_mean_lag2 ) # data.random.covs <- log(dat %>% group_by(site_code) %>% summarize(area_sqmi = unique(area_sqmi)) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(site_code) %>% pull(area_sqmi)) data.random.covs <- dat %>% group_by(site_code) %>% summarize(basin = unique(basin), elev_ft = unique(elev_ft), area_sqmi = unique(area_sqmi)) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(basin) %>% mutate(z_elev_ft = c(scale(elev_ft)), z_area_sqmi = c(scale(area_sqmi))) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(site_code) data.random.basins <- dat %>% group_by(site_code) %>% summarize(basin_code = unique(basin_code)) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(site_code) %>% pull(basin_code) any(is.na(data.random)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] TRUE ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} any(is.na(data.random.covs)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] FALSE ``` ::: ::: Misc. objects ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Ti <- length(unique(dat$year)) # L <- dim(data.random.years)[2] # W.year <- diag(L) ``` ::: Combine data in list ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # combine data in a list jags.data <- list("temp" = dat$tempc_mean, "nFirstObsRows" = nFirstObsRows, "firstObsRows" = firstObsRows, "nEvalRows" = nEvalRows, "evalRows" = evalRows, "X.site" = as.matrix(data.random), "Krandom" = dim(data.random)[2], "nsites" = length(unique(dat$site_name)), "nbasins" = length(unique(dat$basin)), "n" = dim(dat)[1], "site" = dat$site_code, "basin" = data.random.basins, "elev" = data.random.covs %>% pull(z_elev_ft)#, #"area" = data.random.covs %>% pull(z_area_sqmi) ) ``` ::: Parameters to monitor ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} jags.params <- c("temp", "stream.mu", "sigma", "ar1" , "ar1Mean", "ar1SD", "B.site", "sigma.B.site", "alpha.0", "mu.alpha.0", "sigma.alpha.0", "alpha.1", "mu.alpha.1", "sigma.alpha.1", # "alpha.2", "mu.alpha.2", "sigma.alpha.2", # "alpha.3", "mu.alpha.3", "sigma.alpha.3", "residuals", "deviance","R2", "rmse", "loglik" ) ``` ::: ## Fit model ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fit_edcov <- jags.parallel(data = jags.data, inits = NULL, parameters.to.save = jags.params, model.file = "JAGS models/DailyTempModelJAGS_Letcher_hierarchical_modified_site-basin.txt", n.chains = 10, n.thin = 50, n.burnin = 1000, n.iter = 11000, DIC = TRUE) ``` ::: #### Save model ouput Save to file ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} saveRDS(fit_edcov, "Model objects/LetcherTempModel_EcoDrought_hierarchical_full_wCovs_Elev.RDS") ``` ::: Read in fitted model object ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fit_edcov <- readRDS("Model objects/LetcherTempModel_EcoDrought_hierarchical_full_wCovs_Elev.RDS") ``` ::: Get MCMC samples and summary ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} top_mod <- fit_edcov # generate MCMC samples and store as an array modelout <- top_mod$BUGSoutput McmcList <- vector("list", length = dim(modelout$sims.array)[2]) for(i in 1:length(McmcList)) { McmcList[[i]] = coda::as.mcmc(modelout$sims.array[,i,]) } # rbind MCMC samples from 10 chains Mcmcdat <- rbind(McmcList[[1]], McmcList[[2]], McmcList[[3]], McmcList[[4]], McmcList[[5]], McmcList[[6]], McmcList[[7]], McmcList[[8]], McmcList[[9]], McmcList[[10]]) param.summary <- modelout$summary head(param.summary) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` mean sd 2.5% 25% 50% 75% B.site[1,1] 6.981396 0.1536600 6.680877 6.879603 6.985878 7.087351 B.site[2,1] 13.812454 0.3039641 13.250341 13.612359 13.806611 14.007353 B.site[3,1] 14.250872 0.2945390 13.669022 14.049945 14.256800 14.445119 B.site[4,1] 12.628151 0.2765381 12.067737 12.449222 12.624060 12.820394 B.site[5,1] 12.590335 0.2819994 12.030519 12.407845 12.589310 12.780244 B.site[6,1] 6.799256 0.4145647 5.977637 6.506917 6.807260 7.081872 97.5% Rhat n.eff B.site[1,1] 7.287743 1.001674 1700 B.site[2,1] 14.429471 1.001026 2000 B.site[3,1] 14.800687 1.000314 2000 B.site[4,1] 13.159924 1.000883 2000 B.site[5,1] 13.138040 1.000077 2000 B.site[6,1] 7.587016 1.002999 1200 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} rm(fit_ed) ``` ::: #### Check convergence Any problematic R-hat values (>1.05)? ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} top_mod$BUGSoutput$summary[,8][top_mod$BUGSoutput$summary[,8] > 1.05] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` loglik[7119] loglik[7858] loglik[14180] residuals[15553] 1.053644 1.050565 1.053633 1.051596 ``` ::: ::: View traceplots ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} MCMCtrace(top_mod, ind = TRUE, params = c("alpha.0", "alpha.1", "mu.alpha.0", "mu.alpha.1", "sigma", "sigma.alpha.0", "sigma.alpha.1"), pdf = FALSE) ``` ::: Convert to ggs object ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ggfit <- ggmcmc::ggs(coda::as.mcmc(top_mod), keep_original_order = TRUE) head(ggfit) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 6 × 4 Iteration Chain Parameter value 1 1 1 alpha.0[1,1] 10.9 2 2 1 alpha.0[1,1] 11.0 3 3 1 alpha.0[1,1] 12.0 4 4 1 alpha.0[1,1] 12.3 5 5 1 alpha.0[1,1] 12.3 6 6 1 alpha.0[1,1] 10.5 ``` ::: ::: ### LOO-CV *LOO diagnostics indicates that the model generally fits the data well.* ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} loglik <- top_mod$BUGSoutput$sims.list$loglik # extract the log-likelihood estimates for each MCMC sample rf <- relative_eff(exp(loglik), chain_id = rep(1:10, each = 200)) my_loo <- loo(loglik, r_eff = rf) my_loo ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Computed from 2000 by 56051 log-likelihood matrix.
